d: Wavy, burnt-orange hair is tied up in a high ponytail with loose, face-framing bangs and a lime-green headband. Amber eyes are wide with a cheerful expression on a youthful face. The slender build is dressed in a white puff-sleeve blouse under a dark teal waistcoat with bronze buttons, paired with a short white skirt overlaid by a decorative teal and yellow patterned apron with tassels. Signature details include a brown ribbon necktie, a wide-brimmed straw hat resting on the back, a small brown leather pouch at the hip, and brown strappy gladiator sandals.
